kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-count-for-each
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  count = var.create ? 1 : 0
  name  = "q"
}

variable "create" {
  type = bool
}

variable "enabled" {
  type = bool
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  count = var.create && var.enabled ? 1 : 0
  name  = "q"
}

variable "create" {
  type = bool
}

variable "enabled" {
  type = bool
}
